notes.title: Chapter 3 Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32695922/b401e57afcfcba69bf9dfffe402edd5063aa572d.png[/img]

Hey everyone!
It may have cost me a huge amount of work, time and money, but I can now proudly present you the next Chapter of the Donnerwald Experiment series!

Initially planned to be released for Halloween 2021, I took my time to further adjust it as I felt there wasn't enough content yet.
Some things are still "placeholder" like Nikita's skill icons, which I plan to replace over the following weeks and months.

This time, I unlocked the [b]Chapter Selection[/b] feature. While I advise to play the game from the start again, as there are many smaller and bigger changes, I can understand that not everyone wants to see the same stuff over and over again. So this time you can simply simulate your choices from the previous Chapters and directly start at Chapter 2 or 3.

Here's the changelog:

Note: I see a lot of games updating to be more compatible with Steam Deck. I will work on this for TDE once I get my own hands on one.
But right now I'm ultra poor so this has to wait a bit.

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
-If Johanna is knocked out while in the Robot, the sprite no longer glitches out.
-The demon choke attack no longer shows "block" ... I don't know how that ended up there. I'm sorry for that one!
-Fixed the softlock that happens after defeating Nimarus on Day 4.

[h2]Story[/h2]
-The Bonjavelin+Erika event in Chapter 2 now can also happen in the evening (4th slot), before it was just early night (5th slot).
-The "play game" option after the Treasure Hunt (NonPact Route) now properly tells you that you'll get the chance to ask someone out on a date.
-In the rare case you were not going full flirting with Marx during the crimson dream: Added something in Chapter 3 that progresses the "Talk with Erika" choice tree for Marx.

[h2]System[/h2]
-Made Ralf playable (Chapter 3)
-Made Luka playable (Chapter 3)
-Made [Redacted] playable (Chapter 3)
-Made Nikita playable (Chapter 2, Day 3). Note that her icons and balance are not finalized yet.

[h2]Gadgets[/h2]
-Added "Enhanced Wrench" which increases the base damage for Wrench Strike and Wall Shadow by 1.
-Added "Muscle Stimulator" which increases the SP Sink damage for Wrench Strike, Hammer Strike and the Earthquake ability by 1.

[h2]Overworld[/h2]
-Crimson Dream: Alentura now laughs after hitting Johanna in Chapter 2.
-Eleno: There's now something in the top right corner
-Added a Rat in Eleno that gives you cheese once per day.
-Added some items to Geisterkueste. Plz visit the empty beach house.
-Geisterkueste: Added background music.
-Increased Erika Friendship Points from Cookie and from initial talk from 1->2. (So overall 2 more friendship points)
-Increased William Friendship Points from talking to him in Chapter 2.

[h2]Menu[/h2]
-Love Battle options should be more clear now.

[h2]Battle[/h2]

-Buffs that get removed upon taking damage no longer ignore Armor damage.
This means that Bussekater's Good Night buff gets removed even if only the armor was attacked.
-Crows can now target the back line.

[h3]Johanna[/h3]
-Nerfed Earthquake: Now you need 2 SP for each increased damage point. Initial stats from 5DMG-3SP to 3DMG-2SP
-Swapped the position of the robot icons with the "normal" icons (since Johanna is above the robot, it makes more sense that her abilities are also on top)
-Added a sound effect to Robato's Woy Reload skill.
-Wall Shadow: Is easier to hit now

-Mare Noctem Skills: Strength no longer depends on Mare Noctem, instead more Woy can be invested.
-LOVE->LUST: Renamed to LUST due to popular demand. Now heals 3HP and 2SP for each invested Woy Point and drains an enemy's health.
-GUILT: Deals 3- damage for each invested Woy Point. (- means enemies in the backline receive 1 damage less per distance, capped at 1).
-HATE: Wrath duration is now invested Woy Points +1.
-FEAR: Fear duration equals to Woy Points spent. Hits more targets with -1 duration each if it's still greater than 0.

[i]Earthquake is not intended to be always better than the normal hammer attack, hence the changes. It still has its uses against multiple ground enemies.
The Mare Noctem skills felt a bit underwhelming and weird to use, as it promoted the player to play "badly" by losing days in order to get stronger.
And there wasn't a real reason to upgrade Max Woy until now, either.[/i]

[h3]William[/h3]
-Stick Smash now deals 3 damage when fully charged.
It also stuns now even if it's not fully charged.
-Stick Throw now deals 3 damage.

[i]He can now one-shot Wuselrats.[/i]

[h3]Erika[/h3]
-Now starts with only 7 HP.
-Rainbow Potion now cures Apathy Debuff instead of being prevented by it.
Increased Potion Sickness duration from 3 to 4 turns to balance this out.
-Woy[5] ability no longer KOs her teammates, only herself and deals 64 damage to all enemies.

[i]Erika is strong, so strong that she's not available yet except by savefile modding.
By giving her the least amount of HP and  slightly modifying her self-heal, she becomes closer to the cute blonde glass-cannon the I envisioned her to be.[/i]

[h3]Marx[/h3]
-Railgun now can charge all 5 Woy Points instead of only 4.

[i]Just a minor oversight that fixes things in future chapters.[/i]

[h3]Montgomery[/h3]
-Chili P Buff now prevents being Frozen (might be important in Chapter 3)
-Chili P now grants Well-Fed Buff for 3 turns after it ends.

[i]Personally I felt the Chili could use some more extremly minor buffs, to make Montgomery more of a supportive character.[/i]

[h3]Sir Hennryk[/h3]
-No longer gains ALP by using his main attack or Axe Throw.
-Axe Throw now deals +1 damage (-> 3).

[i]Hennryk was a bit too strong in the previous iteration and this felt like the most reasonable change, as it still keeps his good HP pool and potential for explosive damage, but it's less controlable now as the ALP generation now fully depends on him taking damage.[/i]

-Stuns & Freezes can no longer be "refreshed" (affects permastunning enemies like the Donnernatter).


[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
-The following things use placeholder art:
Golden Wire (item), Freezing (Debuff), Muscle Stimulator (Gadget), Wrench Enhancer (Gadget), Luka's 4th skill, Diving Gear (gadget), Nikita's skills.
-There's no "no-hat" version of Alentura's faceset yet.
-The underwater cavern currently has no enemy encounters, thus might feel a bit empty.

notes.title: 1.1.6 hotfix
notes.content:
-------- 1.1.6 Hotfix


#Bugfixes
-Fixed Robot Recharge using Mathf.Max instead of Mathf.Min (healed way too much)
-Fixed Geisterküste enemies not respawning.
-Fixed Nikita having a sleepover with Johanna not showing a friendship increase (visual only).
-Fixed RedRoom being quitable via Chair when Nimarus or Alentura want to talk with you.

#Overworld
-Added a new Erika Art on Day4. Also added an event on Day4 in Erika's room that can be triggered that either grants Friendship or Inspiration.

#Menu
-Crafting: The Totem requires Woy being unlocked instead of Alp now. Though it's not buildable as it requires a currently unobtainable ressource which will appear in Chapter 3.

#Battle
-Johanna no longer uses the ALP meter. Instead, she uses Woy to emulate those nightmare powers.
This ties in better with the way how she gained those Alp abilities in the first place.

Those might be up for further balancing in the future.
-Wall Shadow no longer uses ALP, but costs 2 Stamina instead now.

Known Issues:
The game softlocks in the talk with Montgomery teaching you how to build the monocles.
This happens when you start a new file after finishing the game (without quitting the game).
I'll further investigate on the cause and how to solve it.

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch - Release Patchnotes
notes.content:
Hey hey,

Today the big Quality of Life patch will go live on steam!
It's not Chapter 3, instead the first two chapters (mostly 1) got some uplifting.
This includes story bits but also mechanical wise as well as some balancing and bug fixing.

[h2]Major changes[/h2]
-No more evading in battles, instead it's all blocking
-Charge Attacks can use Stamina for extra damage
-Completly new intro
-New Savesystem (most autosaves were replaced with statue saving).

[i]Also, the patch will remove the russian translation for now as there's been no signs of interest for this patch, though this may change in the future again.[/i]

[b]Savefiles are no longer compatible with this version![/b]

[h2]Art[/h2]
-Replaced old starvation Debuff with a new icon
-Lonely Sand ground replaced with better art (no more mush).
-Most characters now have 3 idle animations instead of 2. You may thank Sarrg for this change.
-Added Coppelius Faceset.
-Added Faceset for Nimarus without hat (thanks Smasho)

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
-Fixed Forest items respawning upon reentering
-Fixed Zamur Cape text saying it's Umami when it's actually Sour.
-Fixed Nimarus stomp target showing the wrong person

[h2]Story[/h2]
-Johanna no longer returns from a 6 month long journey. Instead, something different happens... (fully reworked the intro chapter).

[h2]System[/h2]
-Increased Max Level from 16 to 30
-Added Savepoints and replaced most autosaves with it.
-I'm no longer scared to use bloom shaders in TDE.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
-Erika's shop is now also open at evening. She has to do some overtime work.
-Reworked Woy System in combat. It needs to be channeled like Star Power in PM:TTYD.
-All Charge attacks slightly reworked. You can now pay SP to make the attacks deal more damage during the charge.

[h2]Gadgets[/h2]
-Added diving gear (currently WIP)
-Added shield generator (currently WIP)

[h2]Overworld[/h2]
-Kaltstein: Adjusted lights for the new system, added new "glow" to indicate where to leave.
-Added a guitar sound to Honeiro
-Increased the sell price for most ingredients. It's now always 5 less than the buy price.
-New content for Nikita Day2.
-Nikita Day3 Event requires not having a Woy Pact to side with her.
-Kaltstein: Added warning that leaving advances the plot, added [!] to Jasmine.

[h2]Menu[/h2]
-Doubled Cursor Speed for Overworld Menu
-Levelup and Inspiration Points are now shown as notifications.
-"Unlocked" icon is now more clear.
-Made OW Menu somewhat easier to navigate.

[h2]Battle[/h2]
-Enemies that run away now give half their XP (round down) instead of 0.
-Johanna: Summoning Robato now always fully heals him.
-Fixed yellow potions not applying +1 Action Point modifier correctly
-When a Buff is applied, you receive a message now.
-Enemies now show which character they attack in a more clear way.
-Made Snakes a little bit faster
-Nimarus stomp attack deals 5(9) instead of 8(12) base damage.
-Nimarus earthquake deals 5 instead of 8 damage
-Secret Boss ??? - Laser attack from 4 to 3 base damage
-Secret Boss ??? - HP lifesteal changed from AoE to single target, but base damage increased by 1.
-Replaced all instances of evading with blocking. 
-William: Stick Throw is now like the hat throw. Pierces once, deals 2 damage to each target.
-Selecting a character now skips the "select category" menu, removing one A press.
-Angry Crows now have their HP bar properly placed
-Robato von Brex: Can now also hit medium sized enemies.
-Changed Wolpertinger from Tall to Medium sized enemy group.
-All enemies now start without their HP Bars revealed, as the goggles can now be built pre-Chapter 1.
-Stones & Bones are now useful: 100% stun rate, damage up to 2, changed targeting system.
-Camera is now dynamic for many attacks
-Added Battle Transition for Nimarus
-Marx: Reworked for the new Woy System.

It has been quite from my side for a while, but that's mostly because I'm busy working on TDE Chapter 3 non-stop.

-Overall some bug fixes and adjusted texts.

Stay tuned for more information.

-Wegenbartho

notes.title: Chapter 2 - Release Patchnotes
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LSP1eLy25Sg;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone, it's happening.
With Halloween approaching, it's time to release Chapter 2 of The Donnerwald Experiment on steam.

I hope you'll enjoy Johanna's new adventure, feel free to let me know what you think about it and if you encounter any bugs.

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]
Due to some savefile bugfixing, most old savefiles won't work anymore as the construct information was corrupted. You may instead use the [b]Chapter Selection[/b] in the Start Menu to jump right into Chapter 2 if you don't want to replay Chapter 1.
Sorry for causing this inconvinience.

The [b]russian translation[/b] will be patched in when its done, later this month.

[h1]Art[/h1]
-Exchanged most placeholder icons with the finished versions.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
-Fixed robot information gets saved in a wrong way
-Starting a new game after loading a game kept the characters in the party
-Many minor adjustments

[h1]System[/h1]
-Friendship Value Increases popups now show the exact number in the animation
-Gaining inspiration is now also shown via Popup.
-All items have a yellow name upon pickup (text message).
-Shopping is now in
-Potion Brewing is now in

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
-Levelup MaxHP gives +5 instead of +3.
-Levelup MaxHP also heals 5 HP now.

[h1]Gadgets[/h1]
[b]Spiked Boots[/b]: Reduced inspiration cost from 8 to 6
[b]Super Boots[/b]: Now unlock Power Bounce ability, reduced inspiration cost from 16 to 6
Added [b]Monty-Goggles[/b], which allow to tattle enemies even if Montgomery is not in your party. Can also be used while riding robot

[h1]Overworld[/h1]
-Johanna now waves at Jasmine after being rescued in Kaltstein.
-Johanna now gains 1 Inspiration in Kaltstein after telling Jasmine to appease the overlord
-The Tavern is now also open at morning.
-Lonely Sand spin now has a sound effect

[h1]Menu[/h1]
-Party Menu looks a bit better now
-Status Menu reworked. Johanna's skills and the different skill symbols can now be checked.
-Changed the UI for the selection menu to fit with the rest of the game

[h1]Battle[/h1]

notes.title: 1.0.10.1 Patchnotes
notes.content:
Hey everyone, looks like we got another small update before Chapter 2.

Adding in some additional quality of life features, though on a smaller scale.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
-Fixed the x0 crystal bug.
-The Sandmann now teleports onto Johanna's robot, threatening her with his knife.
-Fixed Jasmine's intro tavern cutscene not giving friendship points

[h1]System[/h1]
-Changed Mare Noctem from being an infection into a curse. You know why.
-Added battle transition effects (with placeholder sound effect).

[h1]Overworld[/h1]
-Morning Background Light improved
-Red Room (Pact Route) slight text changes.
-Removed the stone from the Red Wine dream
-The robot now has landing lag, makes a small shake

[h1]Battle[/h1]
-Seperated BLOCK and EVADE. Now only melee attacks can be blocked and ranged attacks can be evaded.
-Added animation for Johanna she gets hit with 1 or more damage in battle.
-Improved some enemy attack hit effects
-Throw skills and items are now easier to control (bone and William's stick)
-Defeating Woyzeck now shows a victory message.
-Hitting a perfect block (3 frame window) now display a PERFECT! message.
-Johanna's jump attack now has some vertical camera shake.
-Nyx is now worth 8 XP (instead of 2)
-Coppelius Health Bar is no longer visible when not tattled.

[h3]Changed Action Point system, Johanna now always has 2 Action Points regardless of partysize.
Balances Changes due to the new system:[/h3]
-Grounded Crows now have 2 instead of 3 HP.
-Punch costs 2 AP instead of 1 SP.
-All bottles are now "quick items" which don't consume Action Points.


Work on Chapter 2 continues at a good rate, BUT I might need to delay it's release due to some troubles related to the current COVID situation.


That's all for now. 
Thanks again to everyone who played and enjoyed the game so far.

notes.title: The 1.0.10 Quality of Life patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32695922/0d72860d1fabf33e30048b3dd21ab5cb1ae99ca4.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

I decided to release the big QoL update which was originally planned to be part of the Chapter 2 update. Since it's still some months until its release (currently estimated to be the end of May), I thought it would be great especially for new players to gain access to the Menus, Level System and other various improvements already.


[h1]NOTES[/h1]
Starting a new game is advised, as all points gained by leveling up were not awarded in previous versions.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
-Fixed the item duplication bug when loading a game (how did I miss that).
-Small audio volume fixes for some skills.

[h1]System[/h1]
-Text Selections are now shown as the current text appears, instead of after it completly appears to prevent accidental skipping.
-Added an indicator for NPCs in the Overworld (in Eleno), to indicate if they have something new to say. Mostly important for future chapters.
-Added WASD as alternative controls for Keyboard.
-Moved interact from [UP] to [E] on keyboard.
-Enabled Unity Resolution Settings Menu. Can also be used to change hotkeys.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
-Added Friendship System. Engaging with NPCs in a positive ways may net you points, each heart represents 4 points overall.
Mostly important for decisions in future chapters.
-Added Quest System. Should help keeping track about Johanna's current tasks.
-Added LOCK system for text selections.
-Added Level system. The game is finally an RPG.

[h1]Overworld[/h1]
-Removed first three intro text passages.
-Added fully functional Pause Menu with 5 categories (has some placeholder art in certain places).
-Added in Wakeup Signal Sound (retroactively added to Kaltstein in Chapter1).
-Added new Skybox for LonelySand (+battle)
-Added corona effect to "obvious" dream areas.
-Fixed Interact Button sometimes not being registered.
-Added SavePoints to LonelySand and start of Mansion Kaltstein.

[h1]Battle[/h1]
-Nerfed Johanna's starting stamina down, from 3/6 to 2/4.
-Added Shield System for players and enemies.
-Adjusted Buff size and positions, made them smaller.
-Wuselrat (& Stormrat) Hide skill now grants +1 Shield instead of giving +1 physical armor buff.
-Stormrat HP buffed to 5 again. XP from 4 to 5.
-Mr.Foxxie regained his Triple Shine ability. Now gives +3 Shield.
-Mr.Foxxie now gains Well Fed buff if he hits a player with his bite. Lasts for 1 turn.
-Fixed Chili Buff (green) not getting refreshed upon using it again before time runs out.
-Added sound cue indicating the timing of when to release/press a timed action.
-If any Partner has 0 HP at the start of the battle, their HP will be increased to 1 HP. Does not affect PermaKill moves.

[h1]Achievement[/h1]
-Added "See Montgomery, it burns" (Chapter 1)
-Added "Peace was never an option" (for future chapters)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32695922/d1ea2475a6fc072d089a38f9a498af0ad4e02932.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32695922/7aa7f703df64a95886f79f88a7cab6d9918821d2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
-Jasmine's crystal is still in the inventory with 0 charges after defeating Woyzeck.

Starting on monday, the crunch for the next update will begin. I hope you're looking forward to the next page of Johanna's [strike]Bizarre[/strike] Adventure, which will be filled with [b]love[/b], [b]fear [/b]and [b]surprises[/b].

notes.title: 1.0.9.0 Patchnotes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32695922/a727c59062c6bcfab39d451315bdba0158f78b0d.jpg[/img]

Patchnotes (1.0.9.0)

[h1]Future Chapters[/h1]
-Befriending NPCs will now also work if you accepted a pact.
There will be another undisclosed downside instead, so be warned.


[h1]System[/h1]
-Drafted the first two Pausemenu Pages (my work here is not done yet).
-Implemented TextMeshPro
-The StartMenu might change if you die.
-Optimized all Facesets. It cut down the size of the game (2.4GB to 1.6GB) as well as it's RAM usage.
-Adjusted all Faceset heights to match with the intended character heights (Doria taller, Gri smaller).
-Replaced all BOLD texts with YELLOW text.
-You can now interact by pressing UP on the left gamepad stick.

-New flavour Achievement: "Nightmares are simply unfair, don't you think?"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32695922/790ed59588deebf3911fd89a59ae91793340964f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Overworld[/h1]
-Added jumpsound for Johanna.
-Added transition effect when you wake up from a dream. 
And when you die during a nightmare.
-Climb animation is now faster
-Added NPC Bonjavelin to the Prokuri Tower. 
-Jasmine's attack now causes a screenshake at the intro
-Added another intermission after accepting the Woy Pact.
-Game now saves directly before the Pact choice.

[h1]Battles[/h1]
-Dream Demon strangling attack speed up, 10->5 ticks with 1->2 damage each.
-Generally improved the first Dream Demon battle, make it easier to block his attacks.
-Changed Wrench sound to match Fist sound (it fits more against most enemies)
-Punching and using the wrench now have a "hold left and release" Action Command.
They also have more "impact", screenshake+flash and making it more epic.
-Evading/Blocking is now a bit more clear.

That's the last update on the first chapter for now.
Starting tomorrow, my work on Chapter 2 will start.
There might still be some more QoL updates until Chapter2 is finished, but none with focus on additional content.

Best,
Wegenbartho

Another update, this time it brings some more content for the later half of the first chapter.
Previously, there was only one real battle after entering the Dream Machine, but this has now changed.

[h1]Overworld[/h1]
-Add some Fireflies at evening/night to Eleno
-Added two battle encounters in Lonely Sand.
-Added three battle encounters in Mansion Kaltstein
-Added two new rooms to Mansion Kaltstein

notes.title: 1.0.7.4 Patchnotes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32695922/4f9ce97208106d0b51d585f4152e4d7a32068682.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

I hop you enjoyed the game's first chapter so far.
Quite some stuff has changed since release, mostly smaller bugfixes and balance improvements.

[h1]Patchnotes (1.0.7.0 to 1.0.7.4)[/h1]

[h1]System[/h1]
-Replaced Montgomery's typewriter effect. 
The old one is still kept ingame for another purpose in the future.
-[Enter] can now also be used for jumping/confirming text in addition to [space].
-Added Options Menu, so people can now adjust sound volume.
-Heavily optimized the Dream Machine's animation, which should prevent the softlock bug now. 
-Overall file size went down by 800 mb (from 3.2 GB to 2.4 GB).
-Many typo fixes.

[h1]Overworld[/h1]
-Added Dark Shade to Luka's dance area in Eleno, to signify Gri don't like sunlight.
-Stormrats can now be randomly encountered in the overworld.

-Finding the Crystal in Kaltstein is a bit easier (blinks more often)
-Eating the cookie now actually increases Max HP.
-Removed "Door locked" message for William's and Erika's Room at evening (since it can still be opened)
-Fixed Helga not being talkable to after talking with Charla.

[h1]Battle[/h1]
-Turtoise Buff now increases physical defense by 1 while the buff is active.
Affects Wuselrat + Stormrat currently.

[b]Wuselrat:[/b]
-HP decreased by 1 (4 -> 3)
[b]Stormrat:[/b]
-HP decreased by 2 (6 -> 3)

[b]Woyzeck:[/b]
-You can actually lose against him now.
-Breath fire: React time from 0.2 to 0.4 seconds (should be way easier to block/dodge).

[b]Johanna:[/b]
-Jump attack deals 1 damage even if no action command was hit (both still need to be hit for 2 damage).

[b]William:[/b]
-Provides 1 Action Point now (so you can attack two times in Wuselwiese area now).

[b]Mr.Foxxie:[/b]
-HP decreased by 3 (13 -> 10)


Right now I'm working on a small content update, improving the amount of time you'll spend in Kaltstein by adding some encounters and rooms.
Current ETA for this patch is ~22. November, hopefully earlier.

After this, the main focus will be the UI and the content for Chapter 2.
